_comment: Generated by listing this install's own known-marketplaces/installed-plugins records (never hand-edited, never a copy of anyone else's code) - see install-skills.sh. Lists only a marketplace whose OWN registration source is a public git/GitHub repository (checked, not assumed - a marketplace registered from a local directory with no git remote has no public origin to record and is left out, by design, not by omission). A directory-registered warehouse marketplace holding this install's full skill library, and any skill built from this company's own private material or a private task playbook, is never listed here even when it has its own public upstream for other reasons - see docs/v3.md 'Skills install list' section.

skill_router.note: An automatic skill-selection router (decides which installed skill a task should use) is being built separately and is not part of this list yet. Once it ships it will be added here and to harness/OPS_MANIFEST.json's files table - this key is reserved so that addition does not change the manifest's shape.
